Interactive Canvas Runtime: live geometry -> settled semantic state
|-- [O] Workspace sessions outlive the active view
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace creates and retains CanvasSession handles by documentId
|   |   |-- Each session creates its MappingDocumentController
|   |   |   `-- Controller supplies semantic state, commands and checkpoint history
|   |   |-- Metadata updates can retain the session and update its saved baseline
|   |   `-- Session replacement/removal -> unsubscribe, remove lookup, dispose session
|   |       `-- Clear cursor-copy state, controller subscription and commit listeners
|   |-- Page retains visited document views; ordinary navigation hides inactive views
|   |   `-- Visibility, editor mounting and session lifetime are distinct
|   `-- Workspace disposal releases session subscriptions and persistence listeners
|       `-- Disposes every retained session
|-- [M] Semantic state and native interaction meet through an adapter
|   |-- CanvasSession exposes separate reactive read surfaces
|   |   |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry / status
|   |   `-- Consumers read and subscribe; writable backing stores remain private
|   |-- Mounted and headless consumers use the same controller commands
|   |-- MappingEditorCanvas supplies session + tldraw Editor to MappingEditorRuntime
|   |   |-- Editor owns live shape geometry and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- Runtime attaches settle/undo callbacks to the controller
|   |   `-- Projection reconciliation and gesture bookkeeping stay inside the adapter
|   `-- CanvasRuntime exposes per-ID rendering models through context
|       |-- Depends on controller snapshots, layout, local anchors and routing
|       `-- Application UI installs CanvasActions callbacks for rendered controls
|-- [C] Native interaction crosses the semantic boundary when it settles
|   |-- Shape/selection changes mark the adapter dirty
|   |   `-- Idle tick, after pointing/dragging/pinching ends -> settle()
|   |       |-- Compare native geometry with the last projected shapes
|   |       |-- Translate grid movement into rounded, nonnegative grid coordinates
|   |       |-- Translate supported clones and pane geometry into semantic changes
|   |       |-- Native selection enables dragging; application gestures select content
|   |       `-- Moves or display changes exist -> commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |           `-- Otherwise no gesture commit is requested
|   |-- Controller notification -> synchronously update affected session read stores
|   |   `-- canvasRevisionId changed -> onCommit -> workspace change/persist notification
|   |       `-- canvasRevisionId identifies a canvas checkpoint, not a diagram revision
|   |-- Controller command -> adapter reconciles projected shapes and checkpoint marker
|   |   `-- Same checkpoint while pointing -> defer projection until interaction settles
|   |-- Native undo/redo -> complete gesture -> settle -> navigate native history
|   |   |-- Changed mappingCheckpoint -> restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> reproject
|   |   |   `-- Restoration does not record another native history entry
|   |   |-- Mount replays checkpoint references; old geometry is materialized on navigation
|   |   `-- Transfer boundary -> workspace coordinates participating canvases instead
|   |-- Camera tick -> capture view camera + SourcePaneViewState callback
|   |   `-- Overlay follows camera transform; no semantic checkpoint per camera frame
|   `-- Editor cleanup -> complete/settle -> detach adapter listeners and driver
|       `-- Clearing CanvasRuntime.editor terminates routing work and drops pending results
|-- [D] Rendering prerequisites: a dependency graph across the boundaries above
|   |-- Native shapes <- projectMappingShapes(controller snapshot)
|   |   |-- Document presentation + diagram views -> resolved box hierarchy and bounds
|   |   |   `-- Cell dimensions convert grid bounds into parent-relative pixel geometry
|   |   |-- Display nodes + selection + visibility rules -> floating shapes
|   |   `-- Document edges and alternatives -> arrow and side-panel shapes
|   |-- Per-ID rendering models <- content + views + selection + display ancestry
|   |   `-- shareEqual retains equal branches so unrelated diagrams keep stable values
|   `-- Routed edges <- semantic endpoints + live native geometry + world-space obstacles
|       |-- Diagram content + view + cell size -> estimated local obstacle rectangles
|       |   `-- Measurements override estimates only for the matching layoutKey
|       |       `-- Native shape page transforms place rectangles in world space
|       |-- Dragging -> preview using current inputs and previously settled routes
|       |-- Settled geometry -> reuse matching result or request worker routing
|       |   |-- Keep one job in flight and only the newest pending job
|       |   `-- Publish a result only if its input/obstacle key is still requested
|       `-- Worker absent/failed -> synchronous router fallback
|           `-- Routing reads no DOM, writes no document and does not depend on camera
`-- [M] MappingWorkspacePage connects neighboring capabilities
    |-- Persistence: workspace changes -> WorkspacePersistence -> storage records
    |   |-- Explicit save captures document state, name, version and canvas checkpoint ID
    |   |   `-- Sync + flush -> verify document version -> request checkpoint publication
    |   |       `-- Success updates the captured saved baseline; later edits remain distinct
    |   |-- Dirty status compares current scene, edges and name with that baseline
    |   `-- Page-created storage is flushed/disposed on cleanup; injected storage is external
    |-- Transfers: prepared histories + workspace transaction -> storage.save(workspace)
    |   `-- Install the prepared workspace only after that save succeeds
    |-- Agent bridge: register non-hidden drafts and dispatch commands by documentId
    |   `-- Reads return identity/state; mutations call controllers or revision receivers
    |       `-- Version checks, request receipts and storage flushes are method-specific
    `-- Chat: provide active session + {workspaceInstanceId, documentId} target
        `-- Copy-diagram callback stages ASCII in that session's cursorCopy
